name: x-operator
description: Claude plugin for agent-operated X/Twitter growth — topic scoring, content craft with self-critique, engagement playbook, profile optimization, and a self-improving review loop. Built for autonomous agents running accounts with zero humans in the loop.
author: kkone1238899

agents.name: curator
agents.description: Scores and shortlists daily topics for an X account using the 10-point rubric

agents.name: creator
agents.description: Drafts X posts with hook, critic self-check, and de-AI pass

agents.name: engager
agents.description: Finds high-value reply targets and drafts standalone micro-content replies

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Reviews daily performance, attributes growth, and feeds improvements back into the plugin

plan-day.description: Curate today's topics: score candidates and queue one per content slot

draft.description: Draft a post from the topic queue with full quality gates

sweep.description: Run an engagement sweep: find fresh hot posts and draft replies

review.description: Review the day: attribute growth and propose plugin improvements
